channel.title: Wonderfall Blog
channel.description: Practical guides to Mac desktop customization: snow and rain overlays, seasonal effects, decorative lights and custom images.

item.title: Penguins on Your Mac Desktop: Call a Penguin Parade Across the Snow
item.description: Call three penguins onto your Mac desktop with Wonderfall: they run in, belly-slide across the snow, step up onto the Dock, wave and run off by themselves.

item.title: New Year Live Wallpaper for Mac? Add 2027 Lights and Snow Over Your Own
item.description: Give your Mac an animated New Year desktop without a new wallpaper: the New Year light scene, 2027 digit bulbs and gentle snow on top of your own picture.

item.title: KoiArt vs CozyMac vs Wonderfall: Snow Apps for Mac Compared
item.description: KoiArt (US$9) and CozyMac (US$9.99) aren’t in the US Mac App Store. Compare them with Wonderfall, the US$3.99 App Store alternative, checked November 2026.

item.title: How to Put a Christmas Tree on Your Mac Desktop (and Let Santa Fly By)
item.description: Put an animated Christmas tree on your Mac desktop, decorate it, place more trees with Wonderfall 1.6 and let Santa and his reindeer fly across the screen.

item.title: Festivitas Alternatives for Mac in 2026: Christmas Lights, Snow and More
item.description: Festivitas is not on the Mac App Store. Compare six alternatives for Christmas lights and snow, see which are free, and how to switch to Wonderfall.

item.title: Google “Let It Snow” Not Working? What We Found, and How to Get Snow on Your Whole Mac Screen
item.description: We tried Google’s “let it snow” on November 20, 2026: no snow. What the Easter egg did, why sources disagree and how to get snow on your whole Mac screen.

item.title: Christmas Screensaver for Mac: Built-in Options and a Festive Desktop While You Work
item.description: Make a Christmas screensaver on your Mac from your own photos, check old downloads before you open them, and keep snow and lights on screen while you work.

item.title: Wonderfall 1.6: Penguins, a Snowman Wardrobe and More Christmas Trees
item.description: Wonderfall 1.6 brings penguins to your Mac desktop, a wardrobe to dress up your snowman, and more Christmas trees you decorate in place.

item.title: Wonderfall 1.5: Decorate Your Own Christmas Tree, Lights That Sway in the Wind and New Cleaning Vehicles
item.description: Wonderfall 1.5 lets you decorate the Christmas tree on your Mac desktop, makes the lights sway in the wind and lets you pick the vehicle that clears the snow.

item.title: Christmas Apps for Mac in 2026: Lights, Snow, Santa and Trees Compared
item.description: 21 Christmas and snow apps for Mac compared: where the lights hang, whether snow falls over your windows, which add a tree or Santa, and which are free.

item.title: Wonderfall 1.4: Santa, a Christmas Tree and a Rack for Your Tools
item.description: Wonderfall 1.4 sends Santa and his reindeer across your Mac screen, adds a Christmas tree, a tool rack, heavier snowmen and keyboard shortcuts.

item.title: Christmas Wallpaper for Mac Is Not Enough: Make Your Own Animated Christmas Desktop
item.description: Keep any Christmas wallpaper on your Mac or MacBook and add a moving scene you tune yourself: snow, menu bar lights, a decorated tree, Santa and snow drifts.

item.title: SnowMyScreen Is Now Wonderfall: What’s New in Version 1.2
item.description: SnowMyScreen is now Wonderfall. Version 1.2 adds snow drifts and a shovel, Christmas lights with eight scenes, rain, leaves, petals and weather matching.

item.title: How to Put Christmas Lights on Your Mac Screen
item.description: Hang animated Christmas lights along your Mac menu bar, pick a scene or your own colors, let them sway, and see what works for the screen border.

item.title: How to Build a Snowman on Your Mac Desktop (and Dress It Up)
item.description: Let snow pile up on your Mac screen, roll snowballs, stack a snowman and dress it in the Snowman Wardrobe of Wonderfall 1.6, then clear the snow.

item.title: Wonderfall 1.3: Snow on Your Windows, Snowballs and a Snowplow
item.description: Wonderfall 1.3 lets snow settle on top of your Mac windows and move with them, adds snowballs, a snowman, a snowplow and a leaf sweeper.

item.title: Animated Snow on Your Mac: Wallpaper, Screensaver or Overlay?
item.description: Moving wallpaper, snow screensaver or desktop overlay: what each option does on a Mac and how to keep snow falling over your own wallpaper while you work.

item.title: How to Add Snow to Your Mac Desktop (and Other Seasonal Effects)
item.description: Set up falling snow on your Mac, let it pile up and settle on your windows, shovel it away, and try Wonderfall’s other seasonal effects over your wallpaper.
